note: The OLG has a dedicated Categorical Eligibility section under SNAP > Eligibility Requirements that directly addresses this FNS requirement. The OLG clearly defines PA categorical eligibility: all persons in the household must receive or be authorized to receive TAFDC, EAEDC, SSI, or SSP benefits — matching the FNS requirement that all members be authorized to receive PA, SSI, or GA. The OLG also covers NPA categorical eligibility (TANF/Broad-Based CE), combination categorical eligibility groups, loss of categorical eligibility mid-certification, and BEACON automation. The BEACON Determination of Categorical Eligibility section explains that BEACON automatically determines categorical eligibility based on AU Composition Results and income data, bypassing asset tests when applicable, and alerts workers when a member of a categorical eligibility group is disqualified. While the FNS text is framed as QC reviewer verification (verify household composition AORD, verify all members authorized to receive benefits in the sample month), the underlying policy requirement — that PA categorical eligibility requires all members to be receiving/authorized for PA/SSI/GA — is explicitly stated in the OLG with corresponding BEACON procedures.
